stages.name: A Fiery Apparition
stages.caption: No. Ramba spits fiery insults at Mortaccio, her broken heart still burning with rage - but the skeleton ignores her, too busy crying (figuratively) over spilt (and now frozen) milk. But something catches She-Moon's ear in Ramba's scatching rant: the legend of the firebird.
stages.description:
A Fiery Apparition is the third stage of the adventure "To End An Ice Age". This stage is unlocked by opening the coffin that unlocks Bianca Ramba in the preceding stage, Ice Cream.
If the player opens the coffin in this stage, they can unlock Cosmo Pavone, as well as the succeeding stage, A Pure Heart.

stages.name: A Pure Heart
stages.caption: The firebird, Cosmo Pavone, is currently ignoring our heroes and eating toasted seeds. Clearly none of them have truly good intentions, as Cosmo will only aid those of pure heart. She-Moon searches for a real hero, a guardian who will fight for love and justice.
stages.description:
A Pure Heart is the fourth stage of the adventure "To End An Ice Age". This stage is unlocked by opening the coffin that unlocks Cosmo Pavone in the preceding stage, A Fiery Apparition.
If the player opens the coffin in this stage, they can unlock Christine Davain, as well as the succeeding stage, The Rebirth, The Return.

stages.name: Astral Stair
stages.caption: A highway used to reach other worlds and dimensions. It's dangerous to venture through alone, but you probably won't listen to me anyway, will you?
stages.description:
Astral Stair is the fifth challenge stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by reaching level 80 in Inverse Inlaid Library.
Alternatively, Astral Stair and its Hyper version can both be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "recyclethelibrary".

stages.name: Bat Country
stages.caption: We can't stop here.
stages.description:
Bat Country is the fourth challenge stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by reaching level 80 in Inverse Mad Forest.
Alternatively, Bat Country can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "recycletheforest".

stages.name: Boss Rash
stages.caption: The monsters want entertainment, and if we win their game, the loot is ours for the taking. Let us face these recycled assets and do what we do best. survive!
stages.description:
Boss Rash is the third challenge stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by unlocking hyper mode for all 5 normal stages.
Alternatively, Boss Rash can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "peakgamedesign".

stages.name: Cappella Magna
stages.caption: Conceited were they that ruled from so high yet stooped so low. This nexus of debased purity is the perfect place to find a vampire. Probably.
stages.description:
Cappella Magna is the fifth stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked after reaching level 80 in Gallo Tower.
Alternatively, Cappella Magna can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "everywhere".

stages.name: Carlo Cart
stages.caption: Once known as the “King Bible” underground train station, these tunnels beneath the Laborratory now host chaotic, clandestine, and incredibly dangerous go-kart races run by the lizardman King Carlo.
stages.description:
Carlo Cart is the fifth bonus stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by dealing a total of 25,120 damage with the trains found in Laborratory.
The hyper mode for this stage is unlocked by default.
Alternatively, Carlo Cart can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "thenextstopis".

stages.name: Dairy Plant
stages.caption: The birthplace of Milk Magic churns with chaos. Here, it's not just blood that curdles. A secret map awaits the hero brave enough to enter this overthrown factory.
stages.description:
Dairy Plant is the third stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by reaching level 40 in Inlaid Library.
Alternatively, Dairy Plant can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "everywhere".
Reaching level 80 in Dairy Plant while having inverse mode enabled unlocks Mazerella as playable stage.

stages.name: Deep Lore
stages.caption: Imelda has sought a new life in the church - until one night the peace is shattered by a monstrous attack. Backed into a corner, Imelda must call upon her family's power to survive!
stages.description:
Deep Lore is the first stage of the adventure "World of Light and Dark". It is unlocked at the start of this adventure.
If the player survives at least 10 minutes in this stage, they will be able to unlock Inlaid Library, the succeeding stage.

stages.name: Eudaimonia Machine
stages.caption: A space between spaces. The culmination of something, or simply another beginning? Tag, you're it.
stages.description:
Eudaimonia Machine (shortened to Eudaimonia M.) is a special stage in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked after obtaining all the standard relics from all other stages.
The list of required relics includes:
* Grim Grimoire
* Ars Gouda
* Milky Way Map
* Magic Banger
* Sorceress' Tears
* Glass Vizard
* Mindbender
* Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane
* Great Gospel
* Yellow Sign

stages.name: Gallo Tower
stages.caption: An edifice of science and sorcery where horror was made manifest in the name of progress. Its many artifacts and experiments may lead us to what we seek.
stages.description:
Gallo Tower is the fourth stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by reaching level 60 in Dairy Plant.
Alternatively, Gallo Tower can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "everywhere".
Reaching level 80 in Gallo Tower with inverse mode enabled unlocks Tiny Bridge as playable stage.

stages.name: Garlic Paradise
stages.caption: With the terrifying tree righteously slain, Poe can finally achieve his goal: with the power of the Garlic Paradise, he can amass enough riches to retire!
stages.description:
Garlic Paradise is the fifth stage of the adventure "A Garlic Paradise". This stage is unlocked by opening a Jiva Tree in the preceding stage, Rotten Orchard.
If the player reaches at least level 50 in this stage, they will be able to unlock Retirement.

stages.name: Green Acres
stages.caption: Fate changes by the minute in a realm where mortals can only trespass. What rewards wait those who challenge its rules? Treasure? Glory? Poultry?
stages.description:
Green Acres is the first challenge stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by unlocking hyper mode for 2 normal stages (for example, Mad Forest and Dairy Plant).
Alternatively, Green Acres can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "dotgogreenacres".

stages.name: Holy Forbidden
stages.caption: Wait, you can see this too? This isn't right.
stages.description: Holy Forbidden is a hidden stage in Vampire Survivors. It becomes temporarily accessible in Moongolow after defeating the special angel-like boss that spawns at the 14 minute mark during the Lunar Eclipse Event. It is unlocked in stage selection after completing the event for the first time. After obtaining the Yellow Sign, this stage is hidden and can no longer be accessed by stage selection or the event (it can still be accessed by casting the spell “iwanttoseeitagain” using the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane).

stages.name: Ice Age
stages.caption: Amidst a frigid era where all is encased in eternal ice, an unlikely hero decides to rekindle the flame of life and revive the cold bones of this frozen world.
stages.description:
Ice Age is the first stage of the adventure "To End an Ice Age". It is unlocked at the start of that adventure.
If the player opens the coffin that would unlock Mortaccio, they will be able to unlock the second stage, Ice Cream.

stages.name: Ice Cream
stages.caption: Mortaccio's rattling bones make funny noises as he walks with immortal determination, leading She-Moon towards the ruins of a forsaken factory. Is this skeleton moved by the flame of a long lost love?
stages.description:
Ice Cream is the second stage of the adventure "To End An Ice Age". This stage is unlocked by opening the coffin that unlocks Mortaccio in the preceding stage, Ice Age.
If the player opens the coffin in this stage, they can unlock Bianca Ramba, as well as the succeeding stage, A Fiery Apparition.

stages.name: Il Molise
stages.caption: The flowers seem to sing here, calling out to weary heroes. Is such an unspoilt place even real? Does it matter? Is there roast chicken?
stages.description:
Il Molise is the first bonus stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by unlocking hyper mode for any normal stage.
Alternatively, Il Molise can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "relaxenjoylife".

stages.name: Inlaid Library
stages.caption: The Futile Scribe was cursed to know all and understand nothing. His endless library may gift us insight. or damnation. A mask of stone whispers endlessly within.
stages.description:
Inlaid Library is the second stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by reaching level 20 in Mad Forest.
Alternatively, Inlaid Library can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "everywhere".
Reaching level 80 in Inlaid Library while having inverse mode enabled unlocks Astral Stair as playable stage.

stages.name: Laborratory
stages.caption: Formerly the foundry where the famed anti-vampiric weaponologist Santa Ladonna created many trinkets, the Laborratory now lies abandoned. Whispers echo that Santa fled from this makeshift workshop when her experimental alchemy somehow opened a door that was never supposed to be breached.
stages.description:
Laborratory is the seventh challenge stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by collecting a total of 33 Rosaries.
The hyper mode for this stage is unlocked by default.
Alternatively, Laborratory can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "divineassault".

stages.name: Mad Forest
stages.caption: Once a thriving haven, now a dumping ground for evil. A vampire is said to be the root of this evil, but we can find only mayhem and roast chicken.
stages.description:
Mad Forest is the first stage in Vampire Survivors, unlocked from the very start of the game. It is the only stage that is available in the demo version of the game on [https://itch.io itch.io], the others being completely inaccessible, rather than being locked like in the full version of the game.
Reaching level 80 in Mad Forest with inverse mode enabled unlocks Bat Country as playable stage.
Boon Marrabbio (enemy), which is a special enemy, will spawn under certain conditions in Mad Forest after obtaining Yellow Sign.

stages.name: Mazerella
stages.caption: A lactose labyrinth lies buried in the buttery basement of the Dairy Plant. Home to minotaurs and governed by Trickle-down milkonomics. Grabbing the bull by the horns and cheesing it through this mad maze is the only winning formula.
stages.description:
Mazerella is a stage in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by reaching level 80 in Dairy Plant while having Inverse Mode enabled.
Alternatively, Mazerella can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "recycletheplant".

stages.name: Moongolow
stages.caption: Legend tells of a city swallowed by the sea under a full moon's callous watch. Home to mysteries unknown, we ought to see what lies within its walls.
stages.description:
Moongolow is the second bonus stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by unlocking hyper mode for four normal stages.
Alternatively, Moongolow can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "honesty".

stages.name: Old Mad Forest
stages.caption: Poe recalls a simpler time, when surviving the madness of the forest and hoarding masses of garlic was all that mattered.
stages.description:
Old Mad Forest is the first stage of the adventure "A Garlic Paradise". It is unlocked at the start of that adventure.
If the player survives at least 10 minutes in this stage, they will be able to unlock the second stage, Rough Awakening.

stages.name: Planar Bazaar
stages.caption: Coiling betwixt the seconds of forgotten times, allies from the past and future gather in this confusing commercial space to trade items from other realms.
stages.description:
Planar Bazaar is a unique shop stage that is exclusively available in all adventures. It is usually unlocked by reaching level 80 for the first time in any stage of an adventure; the only exception to this is in the Operation Guns adventure, which requires reaching level 80 in Alien Revengeance.
The purpose of Planar Bazaar is to be an area for the player to purchase weapons and passive items, making them permanently available in the adventure that they are playing in. The player can only purchase a maximum of six weapons or passive items at a time before the merchants become unable to sell anything. However, the player can simply exit and reenter Planar Bazaar to make more purchases.
__TOC__

stages.name: Retirement
stages.caption: At last, Poe can retire, and simply stand still forever as he has always dreamed. But will a perfectly sedentary lifestyle be enough for our malodorous hero?
stages.description: Retirement is the sixth and the final stage of the adventure "A Garlic Paradise". This stage is unlocked by reaching at least level 50 in Garlic Paradise, the preceding stage.

stages.name: Risky Woods
stages.caption: O'Sole leads Poe deep into the forest to rescue a holy man with a retirement plan. Perhaps this priest will reward their stinky savior with guidance to the promised land?
stages.description:
Risky Woods is the third stage of the adventure "A Garlic Paradise". This stage is unlocked by surviving at least 15 minutes in the preceding stage, Rough Awakening.
If the player opens the coffin in this stage, they will be able to unlock the succeeding stage, Rotten Orchard.

stages.name: Room 1665
stages.caption: Seemingly bottomless, the down-reaching doors of this huge, infernal contraption open only when fed the blood of monsters. Summoned by the baneful behavior of a long forgotten clan, the unfathomable depths of these haunted halls whisper with a putrid power that yearns for innocent souls to play with.
stages.description: Room 1665 is a hidden stage in Vampire Survivors, unlocked by using the spell "forbiddenbox". As opposed to other spells which typically bypass unlock requirements, using this spell is both the only way to unlock this stage and the intended method, as reflected in the description of the stage's achievement, which explicitly tells players to Dare to cast the spell "forbiddenbox". It contains the Darkasso relic.

stages.name: Rotten Orchard
stages.caption: The path to the Garlic Paradise leads Poe into an orchard of arboreal nightmares. Cut down these pernicious plants to find the verdant fields of dreams.
stages.description:
Rotten Orchard is the fourth chapter in the adventure "A Garlic Paradise". This stage is unlocked by opening the coffin in Risky Woods, the preceding stage.
If the player defeats a Jiva Tree in this stage, they will be able to unlock the succeeding stage, Garlic Paradise.

stages.name: Rough Awakening
stages.caption: A wave of monsters awakens Poe, reminding him that modern life still stink! Perhaps a loyal four-legged friend can shown him the way.
stages.description:
Rough Awakening is the second stage of the adventure "A Garlic Paradise". This stage is unlocked by surviving at least 10 minutes in the preceding stage, Old Mad Forest.
If the player survives at least 15 minutes in this stage, they will be able to unlock the succeeding stage, Risky Woods.

stages.name: Space 54
stages.caption: The 54th ritual is complete, and space itself has folded under the weight of an otherworldly will. This veil between cosmic planes is dimensionally misaligned, phasing in unlikely friends, nightmarish foes, and a curio of immense chaotic potential.|greed=+30%
stages.description: Space 54 is the fourth Bonus Stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by collecting a total of 5 Gold Fingers across any number of runs.

meta.label: Wave Theme
meta.value: Moving the sun and the other stars

stages.name: The Bone Zone
stages.caption: Calcified carnage awaits where the dead go to live. If we speak unholy vespers we will open the way, but should we not go home? Have we not dug too deep?
stages.description:
The Bone Zone is the second challenge stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by unlocking hyper mode for 3 normal stages (for example, Mad Forest, Inlaid Library, and Gallo Tower).
Alternatively, The Bone Zone can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "rottingpizza".

stages.name: The Coop
stages.caption: A farm for fear itself, the beasts reared here have turned from tasty morsels to terrifying monsters after realising the deadly power of cooperation.
stages.description:
The Coop is a stage in Vampire Survivors, unlocked by collecting a total of 500 Floor Chicken, which also unlocks the stage's hyper mode. It contains the Roast Chicken with a Clock in the Middle relic.
Alternatively, The Coop can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "coopwhen".
Parm Aegis is unlocked by picking it up in The Coop as a stage item.

stages.name: The Lycaeum
stages.caption: Myths are murmured of a school submerged beneath a sunlit lake. In silent depths strange fish survive, while at its peak vile evil thrives.
stages.description: The Lycaeum is a stage in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by collecting 50 Vacuums.

stages.name: The Rebirth, The Return
stages.caption: After obtaining the power of the fire, She-Moon can finally make her dreams of Promethean heroism come true: bring Roast Chicken back to the table. Let there be cooked food.
stages.description: The Rebirth, The Return is the fifth and the final stage of the adventure "To End An Ice Age". This stage is unlocked by opening the coffin that unlocks Christine Davain in the preceding stage, A Pure Heart.

stages.name: Tiny Bridge
stages.caption: Two opposing factions abruptly stopped fighting over this little bridge. No doubt the source of this cessation will turn out to be harmless.
stages.description:
Tiny Bridge is the sixth challenge stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by reaching level 80 in Inverse Gallo Tower.
Alternatively, Tiny Bridge can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "recyclethetower".

stages.name: Westwoods
stages.caption: Greed's gone green. Arcane avarice is transforming these once serene woods into a ghoulish gambling den. Welcome to the Cursino, where you need not be a vampire to fear the stakes.
stages.description:
Westwoods is a stage in Vampire Survivors. It, and its Hyper Mode, are unlocked by finding 23 Little Clovers.
Alternatively, Westwoods can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "onebranchbandit".
Surviving 20 minutes in Westwoods unlocks Chula-Reh as playable character.
Karoma's Mana is unlocked by picking it up in Westwoods as stage item.

stages.name: Whiteout
stages.caption: Arctic mirages and a slow, constant snowstorm make this great glacier a hostile environment. Nonetheless, the myths of a powerful weapon, a mysterious potion, and a cursed woman who hates hot springs, make for strong lures.
stages.description: Whiteout is the third Bonus Stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by collecting a total of 20 Orologions across any number of runs.

stages.name: Ante Chamber
stages.caption: Fearsome fools flock to this extradimensional card carnival, where survival is a high-stakes game. The beastly buffoons that prowl this floating funhouse aren’t bluffing, so play your cards right or the joke will be on you.
stages.description: Ante Chamber is a stage in the eponymous DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by obtaining the Joker Disk, which can be bought from Xanthia in Moongolow for 50,000.

stages.name: Emerald Diorama
stages.caption: A miniature replica of a system of interconnected worlds. Emerald Waves guide travellers to their destined paths.
stages.description: Emerald Diorama is a stage in the eponymous DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by obtaining the Emerald Disk, which can be bought from Xanthia in Moongolow for 50,000.

stages.name: Don't Get Ghosted
stages.caption: Following a colony of space rabbits into an underground cave might not have been the best idea. I wonder if this creepy cavern is where all the other Crewmates ended up.
stages.description:
Don't Get Ghosted is the fourth stage of the adventure "Emergency Meeting". To unlock this stage, the player has to defeat a total of 3,000 Moon Ducks in the preceding stage, Ejected.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Space Rocks, the player has to find the Ghost Lino in this stage.

stages.name: Ejected
stages.caption: The vent lead us away from those weird extra-terrestrials, but we seem to have stumbled into a warren of space rabbits and duck astronauts. I suppose we should use this opportunity to research such strange creatures.
stages.description:
Ejected is the third stage of the adventure "Emergency Meeting". This stage is unlocked by finding the Engineer Gino in the preceding stage, Suspect Security.
To unlock the next stage, the player has to defeat a total of 3,000 Moon Ducks in this stage.

stages.name: Emergency Meating
stages.caption: The sudden appearance of those three weirdos has interfered with the experiments in the Specimen Room! Some innovative bean-biology project has gone awry, and a bizzare meat creature is summoning swarms of angry aliens. Whatever it is, we're ejecting it!
stages.description: Emergency Meating is the sixth and the final stage of the adventure "Emergency Meeting". To unlock this stage, the player has to find the Scientist Mina in the preceding stage, Space Rocks.

stages.name: Meeting Called
stages.caption: Red has been called to an Emergency Meeting, but nobody else is here. what's going on?. Why have the doors locked? And were there always so many bins in the meeting room?. Someone needs to report this mess!
stages.description:
Meeting Called is the first stage of the adventure "Emergency Meeting". This stage is unlocked with the adventure.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Suspect Security, the player will have to evolve the Report! with the Mini Crewmate to get the Emergency Meeting.

stages.name: Polus Replica
stages.caption: Summoned to a mysterious science station amongst the stars, survival is far from certain. Extraterrestrial evil and inter-dimensional duplicity lurk behind every space rock.
stages.description: Polus Replica is the first and only stage in the Emergency Meeting DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon owning the Emergency Meeting DLC.

stages.name: Space Rocks
stages.caption: Something suspicious is going on back at the base. Angry aliens are attacking, Crewmates are missing, and all sort of paranormal creatures (though definitely no ghosts) lurk in every corner. Let's figure out what happened using the power of logic and science!
stages.description:
Space Rocks is the fifth stage of the adventure "Emergency Meeting". To unlock this stage, the player has to find the Ghost Lino in the preceding stage, Don't Get Ghosted.
To unlock the next stage, Emergency Meating, the player has to find the Scientist Mina in this stage.

stages.name: Suspect Security
stages.caption: The report got through to HQ, and the station has been placed on lockdown for our safety - which would be very reassuring if we weren't locked outside. Maybe if we can find the Engineer we could sneak back in through the vents.
stages.description:
Suspect Security is the second stage of the adventure "Emergency Meeting". This stage is unlocked by evolving the Report! with the Mini Crewmate to get the Emergency Meeting in the preceding stage, Meeting Called.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Ejected, the player has to find the Engineer Gino in this stage.

stages.name: Red Moon Manor
stages.caption: The mythical place sought by the vile Bloodmoon Clan, said to hide terrible secrets. The relentless pursuit of immortality of its original founders, through atrocious rituals, spawned awful abominations.
stages.description: Red Moon Manor is a stage in the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon owning the DLC.

stages.name: Castle Grounds
stages.caption: Decisive Battle Begin!. Miang vs Orochimario!. Can our Shounen heroine muster the mettle to battle the diabolical dragon for more than a minute?
stages.description:
Castle Grounds is the first stage of the adventure "Legacy of the Moonspell". This stage is unlocked alongside the adventure.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Shrine Valley, the player has to survive at least 1 minute in this stage.

stages.name: Forbidden Peaks
stages.caption: To fight such formidable odds, Miang must search for her flea-bitten twin brother. Follow your nose through the twisting tunnels of the Forbidden Peaks to find the stinky wolfman, Syuuto!
stages.description:
Forbidden Peaks is the third stage of the adventure "Legacy of the Moonspell". This stage is unlocked by opening Menya Moonspell's coffin in the preceding stage, Shrine Valley.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Hidden Cave, the player has to find Syuuto Moonspell's coffin.

stages.name: Frozen Lake
stages.caption: Forging a path across a frozen lake, the reunited Moonspell Clan are assailed by Oni-summoned clones! Can the Moonspell Clan defeat the Frozen Three-thousand, and free Babi-Onna from her chilly prison?
stages.description:
Frozen Lake is the fifth stage of the adventure "Legacy of the Moonspell". This stage is unlocked by defeating Megalo Syuuto Moonspell in the preceding stage, Hidden Cave.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Tanuki Forest, the player has to defeat a total of Madd-Onnas in this stage.

stages.name: Hidden Cave
stages.caption: Catastrophe strikes- the cave floor crumbles and Syuuto is overcome by the slight inconvenience, metamorphosing into his Oni form! Trapped in this hidden chamber, you must tame Megalo Syuuto's unleashed power to survive.
stages.description:
Hidden Cave is the fourth stage of the adventure "Legacy of the Moonspell". This stage is unlocking by opening Syuuto Moonspell's coffin in the preceding stage, Forbidden Peaks.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Frozen Lake, the player has to defeat Megalo Syuuto Moonspell in this stage.

stages.name: Mt. Moonspell
stages.caption: Ancestral Rematch Begin!. At last, the Moonspell Clan strike back to reclaim their home, now overrun by Yokai and Oni. Survive against these otherworldly foes, and strike down the eightfold menace, Orochimario!
stages.description:
Mt. Moonspell is the seventh and the final stage of the adventure "Legacy of the Moonspell". This stage is unlocked by surviving 10 minutes in the preceding stage, Tanuki Forest.
This stage shares similarities with its non-adventure counterpart, Mt.Moonspell, such as the overall design and the enemies that appear in this stage. However, the differences lie in some item spawns and the sequence of waves of enemies.

stages.name: Mt.Moonspell
stages.caption: Ancestral home of a fallen clan, now overrun by yokai and oni. In this world where the sun doesn't shine, the night is victorious.
stages.description: Mt.Moonspell is the first and only stage in the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon owning the DLC.

stages.name: Shrine Valley
stages.caption: Miang barely survives after Orochimario conquers the castle. The trail of vengeance begins with a single step. Miang seeks the guidance of the elder Menya Moonspell in the eastern fields.
stages.description:
Shrine Valley is the second stage of the adventure "Legacy of the Moonspell". This stage is unlocked by surviving at least one minute in the preceding stage, Castle Grounds.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Forbidden Peaks, the player has to open Menya Moonspell's coffin.

stages.name: Tanuki Forest
stages.caption: Babi-Onna is freed from the freeze, and joins the Moonspell Clan as they journey to retake their homeland. Their path takes them through the forest, where a team of tricksy Tanuki assail them with a testing trail - is that a tail, or are you just pleased to see me?
stages.description:
Tanuki Forest is the sixth stage of the adventure "Legacy of the Moonspell". This stage is unlocked by defeating a total of 3,000 of Madd-Onnas in the preceding stage, Frozen Lake.
To unlock Mt. Moonspell, the final stage of the "Legacy of the Moonspell" adventure, the player has to survive 10 minutes in this stage.

stages.name: Clock Tower
stages.caption: Monsters cavort madly amid a towering edifice of clockwork, rising ever upwards to meet an unchanging moon. The heart of the castle holds the key to Dracula's hollow soul, the vile machinations a reflection of his boundless contempt.
stages.description: Clock Tower is the fourth stage of the "Ode to Castlevania" adventure in Vampire Survivors.

stages.name: Devious Woods
stages.caption: Dracula’s castle has risen after a century in ruins, casting a malign shadow over the land, poisoning the hearts of mortals with a thirst for chaos. Brave descendants of the Belmont clan take up their whips and strife through the forest to face their eternal foe.
stages.description: Devious Woods is the first stage of the "Ode to Castlevania" adventure in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by default.

stages.name: Ecclesia
stages.caption: Once home to an avenging order, now infested by the minions of that which they sought to destroy. What temptuous sorceries corrupted the scholars here to bring about this fall from grace? What secrets remain, piled up and undiscovered?
stages.description: Ecclesia is the seventh stage of the "Ode to Castlevania" adventure in Vampire Survivors.

stages.name: Entrance Corridor
stages.caption: A seemingly endless entryway to the home of evil. Take caution traversing this luxurious passage - foulers things than roast chicken lurk between this walls.
stages.description: Entrance Corridor is the second stage of the "Ode to Castlevania" adventure in Vampire Survivors.

stages.name: Long Library
stages.caption: Dracula von Tepes' collection of twisted tomes stretches throughout his accursed manse. His literature is kept in excellent condition by fiendish bookworms.
stages.description: Long Library is the third stage of the "Ode to Castlevania" adventure in Vampire Survivors.

stages.name: Ode to Castlevania
stages.caption: As myriad humans from all over the world joined their vespers in unison, the forces of chaos resonated and granted them their dark wish. The King of Terror raises yet again, and with him his demon castle: Castlevania.
stages.description: Ode to Castlevania is a stage in the eponymous DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon owning the DLC.

stages.name: Sunken City
stages.caption: Built on the bones of a thousand archaic ruins, the foundations of Dracula's Castle are particularly composed of a legendary aquatic city replete with forgotten arcane relics.
stages.description: Sunken City is the sixth stage of the "Ode to Castlevania" adventure in Vampire Survivors.

stages.name: Throne Room
stages.caption: The Vampire hides, invisible in a hall of mirrors festooned with his most frightful followers. Solve his maddening riddle to reveal the awful truth.
stages.description: Throne Room is the fifth stage of the "Ode to Castlevania" adventure in Vampire Survivors.

stages.name: True Infinite Corridor
stages.caption: Time immortal, death immemorial - who's playing who?
stages.description: True Infinite Corridor is the eighth stage of the "Ode to Castlevania" adventure in Vampire Survivors.

stages.name: Alien Revengeance
stages.caption: Great work Contra Unit, you've found the source of the alien invasion. You're our only hope, the only squad strong enough to survive in these stinking egg-spawning grounds - shoot those evil space creatures and win the war for humanity.
stages.description: Alien Revengeance is the sixth and the final stage of the adventure "Operation Guns". This stage is unlocked by having found a new ally in the preceding stage, Run & Gun.

stages.name: Attack Aggressively
stages.caption: Contra Unit, your new orders are in. The president's son has been kidnapped by mercenaries, and they're demanding advanced military technology from Corpo Inc. as ransom - but we don't negotiate with terrorists. You're the only team though enough to take them on. Airdrop into Galuga Jungle, find their base, and blow it the heck up!
stages.description:
Attack Aggressively is the first stage of the adventure "Operation Guns". This stage is available by default.
To unlock the succeeding stage, Bullet Biters, the player has to defeat the Metal Alien.

stages.name: Bullet Biters
stages.caption: Rats! These are no mere mercenaries, they're Red Falcon fighters, traitors of the Alien Wars. We thought that group was destroyed, but it seems like they're back from the dead to kidnap the president's nephew - and they've got you surrounded. Survive until we can send a rescue chopper!
stages.description:
Bullet Biters is the second stage of the adventure "Operation Guns". This stage is unlocked after the player has defeated the Metal Alien in the preceding stage, Attack Aggressively.
To unlock the next stage, Neo City Chaos, the player has to survive at least 15 minutes in this stage.

stages.name: Hectic Highway
stages.caption: Contra Force, rev your jetbikes – its time to drive fast, and fire faster. Red falcon traitors are invading the C-1 Highway for some treasonable reason, and we need you to defend our crucial infrastructure.
stages.description:
Hectic Highway is the second stage in the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by evolving C-U-Laser.
Alternatively, Hectic Highway can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "hardcorpshighspeed".

stages.name: Neo City Chaos
stages.caption: Red Falcon's betrayer bots are trashing Neo City and breaching the defenses of Corpo Inc.'s head office. We don't know what they're after, but it looks like kidnapping the president's cousin's nephew was just a distraction. Crash into downtown and start blasting, Contra Unit.
stages.description:
Neo City Chaos is the third stage of the adventure "Operation Guns". This stage is unlocked by having survived at least 15 minutes in the preceding stage, Bullet Biters.
To unlock the next stage, Operation: Gun City, the player has to kill the M78 after the 10 minute mark.

stages.name: Neo Galuga
stages.caption: Join Contra Force to run and gun across the relentlessly horizontal width of Galuga, from the jungle to Neo City and through the horrors lurking beyond. Let's survive determinedly!
stages.description: Neo Galuga is the first stage in the Operation Guns DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon owning the DLC.

meta.label: Wave Theme
meta.value: Battle in the Jungle - VS version

stages.name: Operation: Gun City
stages.caption: Multiple asteroid impacts have been detected in Neo City and are interfering with our comms. Red Falcon have combined Alien Cells with advanced Corpo Inc. beacon technology and have summoned an invasion force! Civilians have been evacuated, so destroy anything that moves, and see if you can find the president's cousin's nephew's dog.
stages.description:
Operation: Gun City is the fourth stage of the adventure "Operation Guns". This stage is unlocked once the player has defeated the M78 after the 10 minute mark in the preceding stage, Neo City Chaos.
To unlock the next stage, Run & Gun, the player has to defeat the Big Bot Gordea after the 10 minute mark.

stages.name: Run & Gun
stages.caption: Come in, Contra Unit, this is Headquarters. We can't get a read on your position and we aren't exactly sure what's going on without accurate reconnaissance - just keep gunning down aliens and running to the right until we say otherwise.
stages.description:
Run & Gun is the fifth stage of the adventure "Operation Guns". This stage is unlocked once the player has defeated the Big Bot Gordea after the 10 minute mark in the preceding stage, Operation: Gun City.
To unlock the final stage of the Operation Guns adventure, Alien Revengeance, the player has to find a new ally in this stage.

stages.name: Abyss Foscari
stages.caption: Sealed by Luminaire in ancient times to contain the darkness within, these underground ruins are now accessible, but so is the outside world to the evil from the depths.
stages.description: Abyss Foscari is the second stage in the Tides of the Foscari DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked after breaking the green crystal (Seal of the Lake) in Lake Foscari with Keitha Muort and her evolved base weapon, Millionaire.

stages.name: Lake Foscari
stages.caption: An enchanted forest stuffed with fae mysteries and mythological entities. The perfect place to have an average adventure with zero complications.
stages.description: Lake Foscari is the first stage in the Tides of the Foscari DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked upon owning the DLC.

stages.name: The Guardian of the Lake
stages.caption: Once upon a time, sensing a imminent danger, the noble witch Luminaire rushed to seal the tide of evil poised to roll over the world like an apocalyptic flood. Make haste, good witch, or we perish.
stages.description:
The Guardian of the Lake is the second stage of the adventure "Tides of the Foscari". It is unlocked by evolving Genevieve Gruyère's Shadow Servant in The World Eater.
To unlock the succeeding stage, the player has to evolve the Prismatic Missile as Luminaire before 15:00.

stages.name: The Sly Swashbuckler
stages.caption: Once upon a time, Keitha was dossing off. While her schoolmates dressed to the nines and accepted their diplomas, she rejected pomp and circumstance to musk about with the frivolous imps and sprites of Lake.
stages.description:
The Sly Swashbuckler is the third stage of the adventure "Tides of the Foscari". It is unlocked by evolving the Prismatic Missile as Luminaire before 15:00 in The Guardian of the Lake.
To unlock the succeeding stage, the player has to reach level 30 as Keitha Muort.

stages.name: The Star Pupil
stages.caption: Once upon a time, on a normal summer morning, a bright young mage graduated from Foscari Academy with flying colours. With an official diploma tucked under her arm, she ventures into Lake to play magic tricks with the gnome and fairies.
stages.description:
The Star Pupil is the fifth stage of the adventure "Tides of the Foscari". It is unlocked by reaching level 30 in The Undefeated Champion as Maruto Cuts.
To unlock the succeeding stage, the player has to reach level 30 with Eleanor.

stages.name: The True Horror
stages.caption: And they all lived. Happily. Ever. After.
stages.description: The True Horror is the seventh and final stage in the adventure "Tides of the Foscari". It is unlocked by survivng 30 minutes in the Tides of the Foscari chapter of the adventure.

stages.name: The Undefeated Champion
stages.caption: Once upon a time, a doughty warrior faced his daily training routine just before his graduation from the Academy. The trees around Lake always need pruning anyway. All in a day's work for the Red Swordsman, the fabled Champion of Horticulture.
stages.description:
The Undefeated Champion is the fourth stage of the adventure "Tides of the Foscari". It is unlocked by reaching level 30 in The Sly Swashbuckler as Keitha Muort.
To unlock the succeeding stage, the player has to reach level 30 as Maruto Cuts.

stages.name: The World Eater
stages.caption: Once upon a time, in the mists of memory an ambitious witch of unstoppable will sought a monstrous power. The only witnesses to this rite were her mouldering minions, who held back all interlopers.
stages.description:
The World Eater is the first stage of the adventure "Tides of the Foscari". It is unlocked by default, alongside the adventure.
To unlock the succeeding stage, the player must evolve Genevieve Gruyère's Shadow Servant.

stages.name: Tides of the Foscari
stages.caption: Once upon a time, three students, one from each of the houses of Foscari, brave a journey into a forest (called Lake) stuffed with mythological creatures, all to have a jolly adventure, with absolutely nothing interrupting the whimsy.
stages.description:
Tides of the Foscari is the sixth stage of the adventure "Tides of the Foscari". It is unlocked by reaching level 30 in the The Star Pupil chapter of the Tides of the Foscari adventure.
To unlock the succeeding stage, the player must survive 30 minutes.
